decisions.reason: The high-resolution piezo printer was featured on the home page as a new generation of the core coding offer, and a growing firm with slack has no shortfall that would prompt it to drop it.
The numbering software module extends the variable-data printing portfolio at low carrying cost and fits the firm's serialization strategy, so it likely meets aspirations.
Coding non-absorbent surfaces is a core need in the firm's harsh-environment market, and the product shows no sign of falling short of aspirations.
The decoding app succeeds an earlier app and supports traceability, but such small apps are often renamed or folded into others, so the risk of dropping is somewhat higher.
Inline code verification is central to the compliance and end-to-end traceability direction the firm is pursuing, so management has strong reason to keep it.
Layout design software supports common operation across the firm's systems and was promoted on the home page, which suggests satisfactory performance.
